workflow.name: Amazon FBA to NetSuite - FBA Invoice Sync
workflow.description: Scheduled workflow that syncs shipped Amazon FBA orders into NetSuite as Invoices under the default Amazon Customer. It prevents duplicates by searching NetSuite invoices by Amazon Order ID external ID, validates every Amazon SKU before invoice creation, stores all retry records in one memory array, fetches retry orders one at a time, and uses Flow Control email alerts for skipped orders.

assumptions: The existing American Amazon connection exposes all required North America marketplaces and can filter Orders API results to OrderStatus=Shipped and FulfillmentChannel=AFN.
The default NetSuite customer internal ID is 3793910, inferred from the provided NetSuite customer URL.
The confirmed Division value 4 maps to the standard NetSuite department field. If Lionel uses a custom segment for Division, replace netsuite.divisionFieldId before build.
Amazon SellerSKU matches the NetSuite itemid field exactly. If SKU is stored in a custom item field, update the SuiteScript item search before activation.

Amazon item price, shipping, gift wrap, tax, and discount amounts come from the Amazon Orders API order item response. Shipping is mapped to the NetSuite Invoice shippingcost body field, following the existing Sales Order workflow pattern.

Retry memory is maintained in one array key, lionel_fba_invoice_retry_orders. Read it with JSON.parse(input.memory.lionel_fba_invoice_retry_orders || "[]"). Set Memory receives an array object because Gravity stringifies memory values automatically.
Retry order details fetched one-by-one from Amazon are stored in lionel_fba_invoice_retry_fetched_orders before the merge/deduplicate map.
openQuestions: Confirm the initial go-live or limited backfill timestamp for {{CONFIRM_INITIAL_BACKFILL_START_ISO}}.
Confirm NetSuite item internal IDs/names for Amazon gift wrap, tax, and discount lines: {{CONFIRM_NS_GIFT_WRAP_ITEM_ID}}, {{CONFIRM_NS_TAX_ITEM_ID}}, {{CONFIRM_NS_PROMOTION_DISCOUNT_ITEM_ID}}.
Confirm whether Amazon discounts and shipping discounts should be represented as negative invoice item lines, NetSuite discount items, or another NetSuite accounting pattern.
Confirm whether the client sample invoice requires a custom form, terms, posting period, tax code handling, or custom body fields beyond the defaults included here.
implementationNotes: This JSON represents corrections to an already-created Gravity workflow. Update the existing workflow rather than creating a duplicate.
Do not create one memory key per retry record. All retry records must live in the lionel_fba_invoice_retry_orders array.
Use Flow Control with Send Email enabled for mismatch and invalid-order alerts. Do not use separate Email steps for those alerts.
The Amazon retry order lookup must fetch one Amazon Order ID at a time inside the retry loop because the connector action does not accept multiple order IDs.

Verify whether Set Memory updates input.memory for later same-run map steps. If Gravity does not expose updated memory during the same run, use the closest supported accumulator pattern but keep the same two memory keys and report the adaptation.
The merge step filters retry fetched cache entries against the current retry queue to prevent stale cached orders from being reprocessed.
Step 10 intentionally reads fetched retry orders only from input.memory[retryFetchedOrdersKey]. It must not read the Amazon retry loop action output directly after the loop.
Shipping is not represented as an invoice item line. The payload carries shippingCost and NetSuite - Create Invoice sets the Invoice body field shippingcost when shippingCost > 0.
Keep the workflow inactive until placeholders are replaced and a sandbox invoice is approved by Ari and Jeff.
All NetSuite invoice creates happen after duplicate search and full SKU validation; missing or duplicate items must skip the entire order.
NetSuite - Create Invoice declares payload inside execute() so Gravity/NetSuite execution scoping cannot drop the payload variable.
Header location remains NetSuite location 32 while item sublist lines use lineItemLocation 152 to affect inventory at that location.
